items.title: Vice City Highway Patrol
items.description: Protect and serve... or just camp the highways with a radar gun. High-stress job requiring strict adherence to the Penal Code.
responsibilities: Patrol state highways and enforce traffic laws
Issue citations and conduct sobriety checks
PIT maneuver authorized pursuit protocols
Process seized vehicles and contraband
requirements: Pass written Penal Code exam
Mandatory voice comms (no text-only cops)
Complete 2-week field training with senior officer
Zero tolerance for fail RP or NVL behavior

items.title: Asset Liquidator
items.salary_range: To the moon (if you don't get busted)
items.description: Moving product from the Everglades swamps straight into the neon clubs of Vice City. High risk, maximum payout.
responsibilities: Coordinate supply runs from swamp stash to urban distributors
Manage corner boys and territory assignments
Negotiate wholesale pricing with rival factions
Counter-surveil undercover units in the area
requirements: Gang affiliation OR proven solo operation track record
Radio comms for lookout network
Lawyer on speed dial — you WILL need one
Basic understanding of server heat/wanted mechanics

items.title: Malibu Club Bartender / DJ
items.description: The heart of the Vice City nightlife. Keep the locals hydrated, spin the finest synthwave tracks, and listen to gangsters venting about their problems.
responsibilities: Manage drink orders and custom mixing minigame
Host live DJ sets via audio-stream integration
Coordinate with security to remove troublemakers
Build regulars base for larger tip income
requirements: Approved by club management (whitelist slot)
Mic presence and willingness to entertain
Knowledge of Vice City FM track catalog helps
No pulling weapons behind the bar. Seriously.

items.title: Downtown EMS Paramedic
items.description: The only thing stopping the server from turning into a total perma-death graveyard. High-speed driving, constant chaos, zero recognition.
responsibilities: Respond to downed players and trauma calls citywide
Perform triage and field stabilization RP
Transport critical patients to Shady Palms Hospital
File injury reports for legal proceedings
requirements: Whitelist application with roleplay scenario test
Must own a mic — no silent paramedics
Knowledge of basic trauma RP mechanics
Prepared to work active shooter scenes (no immunity)

items.title: Bayview Customs Mechanic
items.description: Where street racers and cartel money converge. If it has wheels, you fix it, tune it, or spray it a different color to lose the cops. No questions asked.
responsibilities: Accept vehicle repair and customization jobs
Run performance tuning for sanctioned race circuits
Accept off-books spray jobs from "motivated" clients
Operate a discreet underground vehicle stash service
requirements: Mechanical RP knowledge (flavor, not IRL required)
Affiliation with at least one street racing crew recommended
Understand that some clients' paperwork may be incomplete
Not a cop. Not a fed. Proven.

items.title: Weazel News Photojournalist
items.description: If it bleeds, it leads. Chase cop pursuits, film gang wars from rooftops, and sell your footage to the highest bidding editor. Die for content.
responsibilities: Cover breaking incidents across Vice City in real time
Conduct field interviews with suspects and officials
Broadcast live feeds to in-game TVs across server
Sell exclusive footage to faction leadership
requirements: Streaming or recording setup is a major advantage
Press pass application through Weazel News admin
No partisan affiliation (everyone will hate you equally)
Accept that your press pass stops zero bullets
